model.name: Pospischil 2008 low-threshold-spiking (LTS) cell
model.citation: Pospischil M, Toledo-Rodriguez M, Monier C, Piwkowska Z, Bal T, Fregnac Y, Markram H, Destexhe A (2008). Minimal Hodgkin-Huxley type models for different classes of cortical and thalamic neurons. Biol Cybern 99(4-5):427-441. doi:10.1007/s00422-008-0263-8
model.expected_behavior: Single compartment; adds T-type Ca (IT, custom LEMS gate types) and a Ca pool. Expected low-threshold burst onset and post-inhibitory rebound (rebound unverified). Late spike times are strongly dt-sensitive under forward Euler (pilot dt probe).
model.inclusion_reason: Pilot fixture 2: T-current / rebound behaviour; valid under jnml -validate (fails strict libNeuroML XSD because of custom ComponentTypes)
